items.heading: Couscous Tunisien
details: Key ingredients: couscous, lamb, vegetables, harissa
Steam couscous over a simmering pot of lamb and vegetable stew.
Cook the lamb with carrots, chickpeas and turnips until tender.
Fluff the steamed couscous with a little oil and broth.
Serve topped with the stew and a spoonful of harissa on the side.

items.heading: Brik
details: Key ingredients: thin pastry, egg, tuna, capers
Lay a thin sheet of pastry (malsouka) flat.
Add a spoonful of tuna, capers and a raw egg in the center.
Fold the pastry into a triangle, sealing the egg inside.
Fry quickly in hot oil until crisp and golden, keeping the yolk runny.
